source_behavior.summary: The current AIMWWeb MainLayout renders an explicit accessible command-palette close control bound to CloseCommandPalette, closes on the overlay, advertises Escape-to-close in its dialog help, and CloseCommandPalette only transitions the local command-open state to false.
source_behavior.side_effects: No persistence, queue, WordPress, provider, resource mutation, success receipt, or navigation mutation belongs to this operation.

dependency_base.note: PR #309 explicitly owns OpenCommandPalette and excludes CloseCommandPalette. This worker stacks on its exact-green head rather than duplicating its behavior.

behavior: The real command-palette close button carries canonical operation AIMW-AI-D3A8A100B4 and source-equivalent accessible Close search naming.
While the real dialog is open, one document Escape listener consumes Escape and invokes the real React onClose state transition.
The existing real backdrop close path remains bound to the same onClose state transition.
The exact command-palette trigger is captured through a React ref and focus is restored after every dialog close/unmount path.
OpenCommandPalette capability filtering, activation-time authorization recheck, authoritative tenant routing, and query-reset behavior from PR #309 remain unchanged.

runtime_path.path: authenticated tenant shell -> Quick Search/Ctrl+K -> real command dialog -> Close search button OR Escape OR backdrop -> dialog state closed -> focus restored to command-palette-trigger

authorization.shell_contract: GET /tenants/{tenant}/context is guarded by auth + tenant.context and authorizes tenant.view.
authorization.semantics: The close operation has no independent server permission because it only dismisses already-rendered browser-local tenant UI. It cannot broaden the already-proven command-palette destination permissions.

proof: A user without membership in the requested foreign tenant receives 404.
Authorized context returns the authoritative active tenant and its permissions.
Closing the palette sends no request and changes no tenant route or resource identifier.

proved: Exact canonical close-button binding and accessible close name.
Escape keyboard close with the event consumed.
Focus restoration to the exact trigger after every close path.
OpenCommandPalette dependency still opens, filters, navigates, rechecks capability, and resets its query with the updated accessible close name.
Exact canonical reconciliation identity remains PENDING before this isolated adaptation.
Guest 401, missing tenant.view 403, foreign tenant 404, and authoritative active-tenant context.

dependency_stack_before_this_operation.note: PR #309 contributes the immediately preceding isolated terminal operation but generated reconciliation remains intentionally untouched.

finalization.exact_head_rule: The commit containing this JSON is independently required to pass the same authoritative PR checks; its SHA and runs are recorded in PR #310 and Issue #257 because a file cannot embed the SHA of the commit that contains itself.
finalization.note: Implementation SHA and the preceding evidence-bearing SHA are both exact-head green. The final metadata-only evidence closure commit must also be exact-head green before delivery.
